title: Angry Alan thoughts:@Joe Weinberg  . . #theatre #broadway #theoffice ...
transcript: ok I'm gonna rank the cast members of The Office that I've seen do theatre recently *FIVE* different cast members of The Office have performed in major stage productions in New York City in the last year or so a year and change and I'm gonna rank them by how good I thought they were in those stage shows quick honourable mention to Ellie Kemper who was in Peter Pan goes wrong on Broadway two years ago which I probably would have included except I did and see her in it in last place I have Melora Hardin who played Jan in the office of course and she was in McNeal on Broadway opposite Robert Downey Jr this really wasn't her fault it was a small role that was poorly written and poorly directed in a similar vein I have Amy Ryan who played Holly in the office and she was in Doubt on Broadway I also don't blame her for this she actually stepped into the role last minute as an emergency replacement and by that standard she did a fantastic, heroic job and even the fact that I found it to be a bit of a thin caricature take on the character I blame on the director because I felt that way about some of the other cast members as well in third place I have Rainn Wilson who was in Urinetown at Encore's earlier this year and I thought he was really funny perfectly cast as this villain character and a better singer than I was expecting although I guess he sings a few times on The Office in second place Steve Carell playing the title role in Uncle Vanya some people said it was like he was too much playing himself but I thought that his mannerisms and his acting style was actually a perfect fit for the tragicomic tone of the character he also brought kind of a tender vulnerability to the character that I hadn't necessarily seen before it was like he was a sad puppy dog in some scenes but in first place and this one is currently running in New York John Krasinski in Angry Alan not only does he carry the whole show on his back and takes character on a complex emotional journey but like I said in my review which I'll link in the caption if you didn't see it he has to strike this really careful balance where you sympathize with him even as you hate every word that comes out of his mouth that's my ranking I'm curious to hear what other people's ranking would be of the performances that you saw and also which cast member of The Office would you like to see on stage next? Jenna Fischer is actually doing a show in Chicago in the fall, I believe personally, the one I'd most like to see would be Mindy Kaling
